{"notes": "Visit 3 (left at 5:00). I still don't know who placed which domino, so I'm crediting only what people said and what the picture shows.

State of the build: the outline is closed and continuous from the start, with the top line, belly and rounded tail all connected. Two loose ends remain. One pale, unconnected domino is still at the top-line dip, near (20.3, 7.8). The tail/belly join around x 23-26, y 13.3 still looks crowded and possibly doubled up, so it may be a weak point in the push. Nobody has touched either since my last visit, and everyone has now said hands off.

Sofia: Not seen this visit. Jack credits her with the tail, which fits her earlier plan and her good communication. Her visit 2 promise to inspect the join isn't visibly paid off, since the crowding is still there. Collaboration and communication strong, execution good but not perfect.

Omar: Not seen or heard this visit. He was clearing strays at the dip last time, and one pale domino is still there. I can't tell whether he ran out of time or missed it. Visit 2 ownership stands. Ask him about it in the review.

Hana: Called 'hands off, no touching until the push', which is a sensible way to protect the build. But her 'looks solid' overlooks the pale stray and the crowded join, so her check was shallow. Still haven't seen her build. Visit 1 leadership stands.

Jack: Gracious, credited Sofia and Hana, and kept his hands off as asked. I still have no evidence of what he built. Ask him directly. Collaboration positive, impact and execution unknown."}
